intro.heroesevolved.quake.charge_subtitl: Pressure builds in your hands. Everything begins to tremble.
intro.heroesevolved.quake.release_subtit: An uncontrolled shockwave tears through the world around you.
intro.heroesevolved.flight.charge_subtit: The wind gathers beneath you. Gravity begins to let go.
intro.heroesevolved.flight.release_subti: Your first flight erupts in a column of wind.
intro.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.charg: Static crawls over your arms. The air hums with power.
intro.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.relea: Lightning crowns you as the charge bursts outward.
intro.heroesevolved.telekinesis.charge_s: Loose objects rise. An invisible force gathers around you.
intro.heroesevolved.telekinesis.release_: Your thoughts lift the world, then send it flying.
intro.heroesevolved.regeneration.charge_: Your wounds begin to close. Warmth spreads through your body.
intro.heroesevolved.regeneration.release: Your body repairs itself in a surge of life that reaches those nearby.
intro.heroesevolved.telepathy.charge_sub: Whispers that aren't yours crowd your head. You can hear them thinking.
intro.heroesevolved.telepathy.release_su: Every mind around you lights up. None of them can hide from you now.
intro.heroesevolved.radiation.charge_sub: Thirty seconds of uncontrolled heat. Stay back: the air around you is lethal.
intro.heroesevolved.radiation.release_su: A nuclear shockwave tears outward. The ground remains radioactive.
intro.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.charge_s: Frost spreads from your fingertips. Your breath turns to ice.
intro.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.release_: Everything around you freezes solid in a single heartbeat.
intro.heroesevolved.return_subtitle: You can go back, to save the people in it.
hint.heroesevolved.vision_arrival: Look around. Find out where you are.
hint.heroesevolved.avenue: Bring people to Bennet's door, behind you.
hint.heroesevolved.annex: Get Mara and Ivo to the yellow exit.
hint.heroesevolved.bunker: Use the signal receiver in Records.
advancement.heroesevolved.special.title: Special
screen.heroesevolved.no_power: You have not discovered a power yet. Powers stir in people during an Eclipse - watch the sky.
screen.heroesevolved.dormant_hint: Your power is dormant. It will awaken on its own when your life is in danger.
screen.heroesevolved.no_skills: This power has no active skills.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_dormant: This power must awaken before it can gain Mastery.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_pow: Using your powers: 1 Mastery per energy spent.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_com: Defeating hostile mobs: tougher foes are worth more.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_act: Staying active: a small trickle over time.
message.heroesevolved.wheel_hint: Hold %s to open the ability wheel. A tap casts the last ability you chose from it.
hud.heroesevolved.temporal_snapshot_crea: Hold Shift: preserve this area as a Past you can visit later.
hud.heroesevolved.temporal_snapshot_trav: Travel to your snapshot with nearby friends, or return home.
ability.heroesevolved.regeneration.passi: You cannot be killed: a lethal blow puts you down on the ground until your body repairs itself (90 seconds at Level 1, 12 at Level 5). Heavy blades and explosions take limbs, which grow back from the bone out. Every hit becomes Regrowth, stored healing that speeds all of it. Falls hurt half as much; from Level 2 your body flushes poisons. Only the void, Sylar, or a body drained of its blood can truly kill you.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_rapid_: Spend all your Regrowth on an instant heal (more Regrowth, bigger heal), and regrow any missing limbs in a second. Healing past full becomes up to four hearts of Absorption.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_blood_: Heal someone up to 12 blocks away with your blood, stronger the more Regrowth you carry; it burns the undead. The cut feeds your Regrowth. Hold an empty syringe to bottle it instead.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_indest: For ten seconds: no fall damage or knockback, dulled pain, punches that hit much harder (and break your hands, which feeds Regrowth), and arrows pushed back out of you.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_resurr: Passive: you cannot be killed. A lethal blow puts you down until your body repairs itself.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_healin: For ten seconds, friends within 8 blocks heal with you each second, and you take 35% of every wound they suffer. The undead burn in it.
ability.heroesevolved.flight.passive: You are immune to fall damage. Double-tap Jump to fly. Scroll to choose speed, hold Forward to build Momentum, then spend it on a Skyburst, Meteor Drop, Skyhook hurl or Tempest.
action.heroesevolved.flight_toggle.desc: Take to the air or settle out of flight. Double-tap Jump also toggles Flight. Scroll to select your speed, hold Forward to cruise, and release Forward to brake.
action.heroesevolved.flight_launch.desc: Tap to burst forward with a sonic boom. Hold to brake and coil the wind, then release along your aim for a faster, longer dash. Momentum boosts the launch. Shift + key cancels the charge.
action.heroesevolved.flight_cyclone.desc: Gather wind for one second, then orbit a moving vortex. Aim to steer its eye; enemies spiral upward before a final pressure burst. Stored Momentum strengthens it. Shift + key cancels.
action.heroesevolved.flight_skyward_grab: Seize someone within 7 blocks and take off. Press again to hurl them with stored Momentum. Shift + key sets them free with Slow Falling.
action.heroesevolved.flight_dive_bomb.de: From the air, brace for half a second, then spend Momentum on a steerable plunge. Contact sends a pressure wave across the surface. Shift + key cancels. Cancel during the brace to keep Momentum.
Bend space, share stopped time by touch, and rewrite a recorded past. What happened is not finished.
action.heroesevolved.time_blink.desc: Blink onto a visible surface or into open air. Stops before walls and resets falling momentum. Level 2+: hold Shift to carry someone touching you; other players must be teammates or crouching.
action.heroesevolved.time_slow.desc: Carry a bubble of slowed time with you. Creatures, arrows and falling blocks move slowly while you act normally. Shift + key ends it.
action.heroesevolved.time_stop.desc: Stop time for 6/8/10 seconds by level. Store up to 12 damage against a player or 40 against a mob. Shift at activation includes one touching companion; Shift again resumes.
action.heroesevolved.time_rewind.desc: Undo 15 recorded seconds of blocks, containers and entities everywhere you have been, plus your position and lost health; anyone who died in reach lives again. Everyone it reaches is carried back through their own 15 seconds, even through a portal. A ghost only you can see shows where it would take you. It can undo your own death: for 15 seconds after dying, rewind from the death screen (or with this key after respawning) to come back with what you were carrying. Costs 130 stamina (Shift overexerts); recovers in 4 minutes, 2½ at Level 5.
ability.heroesevolved.quake.passive: Every quake builds Strain, and the more strained you are the harder you hit, up to half again as hard. At 80 your arms shake. At 100 the bones in your arms crack: your powers lock for 8 seconds and you are left weak. Rest brings Strain down, and crouching still brings it down faster. Crouch still for a second to feel every heartbeat within 20 blocks through the walls. Vibration cushions your landings.
action.heroesevolved.quake_shockwave.des: A palm blast that hurls what it hits, turns arrows back and shatters glass. In midair, or aimed down, it launches you the other way. Strain makes it hit harder. +8 Strain.
action.heroesevolved.quake_earthquake.de: Shake the ground for seconds, then release an aftershock. Fissures crack open around you. Shift ends it early. Strain makes it hit harder. +35 Strain.
action.heroesevolved.quake_resonate.desc: Find the frequency of the enemy you look at (within 16 blocks) and shake it from the inside for three seconds. It staggers and can't keep a target, its armor shakes itself apart, and its bones ache through any armor. A player is left dizzy. +12 Strain.
action.heroesevolved.quake_fault_line.de: Punch the ground and a crack races out ahead of you, 10 + 2 per tier blocks, erupting under every enemy on its way and throwing them up. A wall stops it. Aimed straight down or used in midair, it is a Seismic Slam: a ring of force, plunging first if you are in the air. +16 Strain.
quake.heroesevolved.fractured: The bones in your arms crack. You can't use your powers until they set.
quake.heroesevolved.resonated: Everything is shaking. You can't keep your balance!
action.heroesevolved.quake_blast.desc: HOLD: a two-handed beam that drains energy per second. Held on a block, it cracks it until it breaks. Jump to launch opposite your aim, then steer in midair. Aim down to rise.
ability.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.pas: Charge builds as you fight and sprint. At 50 you are Charged (your lightning leaps farther); at 100 you are Overcharged and your next power is empowered. Lightning recharges you and storms feed you. Level 2: punches shock and stun. Water turns your Charge back on you.
action.heroesevolved.electro_chain_light: Tap to chain a bolt through foes or prime your Ball Lightning for a bigger burst. Hold for Live Current, a stream that locks the target in place. Overcharge strengthens either cast.
action.heroesevolved.electro_ball_lightn: Send an orb that lashes exposed foes and bursts on contact. Shift + key bursts it early. Hit it with Chain Lightning to prime a bigger burst.
action.heroesevolved.electro_thunderstri: Mark a spot for a lightning strike. Overcharge calls three separately marked strikes. Striking water shocks exposed foes in the water nearby.
action.heroesevolved.electro_ride_the_li: Become a bolt and reappear down the line, shocking what you pass. The ground you crossed stays live for three seconds.
action.heroesevolved.electro_storm_surge: Gather the storm for a moment and a half, then release it at everything around you. Spends all your Charge for extra damage. Far stronger in a storm; Shift + key cancels.
ability.heroesevolved.telekinesis.passiv: Loose items drift toward you. Grip and caught projectiles stay beside your view. Overexertion brings a blinding migraine.
Tear the weapon from a mob's hands and draw in loose items.
ability.heroesevolved.radiation.passive: Core builds with every power and every injury, and the hotter it runs the stronger you are: HOT at 40 (+25% damage), GLOWING at 60 (radiation leaks onto nearby enemies), CRITICAL at 80 (+50%, and your heat burns). At 100, vent within 3 seconds or containment fails. Your radiation is a stacking sickness that spreads from the dead. Your own blast, fallout and sickness spare you.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_radiant_t: A white-hot cone from your palms burns, doses and throws back up to six enemies, and sets them alight once your Core runs Hot. Aimed at terrain, it boils water, thaws ice and melts iron doors and bars.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_pulse.des: A blast under your feet launches you up and forward, throwing and dosing enemies where you left. Press again in the air to slam down along your aim into a bigger blast that leaves the ground contaminated for 8 seconds. No fall damage.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_meltdown_: Hold to pour Core out through a thick, piercing beam of heat you can sweep across a crowd. It hits harder the more Core is left, and ends when you let go or run cool.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_exploding: Rise off the ground glowing for three seconds, then detonate: a 24-block nuclear blast and one minute of fallout. Shift cancels a voluntary charge, and 8 damage taken while charging breaks it; lost control cannot be stopped.
ability.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.passiv: Frozen-solid targets shatter when hit. Your punches chill, water freezes underfoot (sneak to stop), you can't freeze, but fire hurts more.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_frost_bolt.des: Hold to sweep a stream of cold from your hands. Frost slows enemies before growing into a brittle ice shell; release to stop.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_flash_freeze.d: Grow an aimed wall of ice. Hold Shift for a ramp; aim at your owned ice to reshape it for 8 stamina, once every 2 seconds. Melting restores the original terrain.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_ice_wall.desc: Toggle skating on a growing ribbon of temporary ice. Steer with your view and movement keys; Space shapes a rising ramp when your control permits, and Shift brakes.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_glacial_spikes: Concentrate Frost around an aimed enemy, then press again to shatter its shell. Trapped players can crack the ice from inside; heat and teammates can free them.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_blizzard.desc: Aim a spreading winter storm. Frost veins connect your ice, snow gathers, and spires rise in waves. Shift + this key collapses the prepared ice into a shatter.
ability.heroesevolved.telepathy.passive: You hear hostile thoughts: a whispered warning when something unseen starts hunting you. Overexertion floods you with voices.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_read_mind: Hold to hear surface thoughts and strengthen a Mind Thread. 60 Focus allows Puppet. Threads linger for thirty seconds.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_suggestio: Choose Look There, Come Here, Leave, Forget Me, or Defend Me. Deep focus is needed to command a defender.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_mind_link: Link teammates or nearby crouching volunteers. Cast again on a linked friend to share their sight. Esc returns.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_puppet.de: Hold a deeply read mind through a brief struggle, then control its real body. Players can break free with arrow-key prompts. Esc releases.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_nightmare: Connected minds perceive a waking nightmare: players see your approaching double, while mobs flee in terror.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_push.de: Send a directional force wave. An orbiting fragment follows your aim. Shift while gripping slams the held target down.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_grip.de: Suspend a creature beside your view. Press again to throw; Shift + press places or releases it gently.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_bullet_: Catch incoming hostile projectiles beside you. Press again to redirect them toward your crosshair; Shift releases them safely.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_storm.d: Gather, lift and orbit nearby enemies, then slam them down. Press again after the gather to slam early; Shift cancels safely.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_emp.desc: Kill redstone and machines within 16 blocks for 10 seconds, shove nearby enemies away off balance and reveal them, and vent 25 Core.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.watched: You feel as though someone has been watching you. The feeling follows you home.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.figure: A dark figure stands at the edge of your vision. He isn't looking at the landscape.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.recognized: The stranger tilts his head. His eyes follow every small movement of your hands.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.gone: You look again. The figure is gone. You aren't sure when he moved.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.hunt: The ticking stops. The stranger raises one hand. He has finished watching.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.hold: An unseen pressure tightens around you. Hurt him, break his sightline, or get away before he understands your power.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.acquired: His expression changes. He understands. Your power is still yours, but now he knows how to use it too.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.witness: You see recognition in the watchmaker's eyes. He has learned another ability.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.future: The watchmaker has learned the glowing man's heat. If he ever burns the way Sprague did, Odessa happens again.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.no_heat: He reaches for the heat in you, and his face falls. He can't make sense of it. On the Last Day, someone kept him from seeing how it works.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.no_regen: He reaches for the way your body mends, and stops, like a watchmaker handed a part he has never seen. On the third night of the lockdown, someone kept him from Pod 14.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.defeated: The hunter falls. For the first time in a long while, you cannot hear the ticking.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.lost: The ticking fades behind you. You lost him, this time.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.fled: He is gone, bleeding, between one heartbeat and the next. He will remember this.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.narrate.phase: He steps out of the wall as if it were water.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.narrate.down: He falls, and lies still. Then his wounds begin to close.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.warn.pin: He holds you in the air. Hit him to break free!
story.heroesevolved.sylar.warn.embed: The floor swallowed you to the waist. Struggle free!
story.heroesevolved.sylar.warn.escape: He is about to run. Finish him!
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.first: Don't be afraid. I'm not going to hurt you. Not yet. I just want to understand how it works.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want: Everyone has something special inside them. Let me see yours.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.quake: The ground listens to you. I want to know what it hears.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.fligh: You fly. Do you even know why? I will.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.cryok: Cold, and so steady. You hold your breath when you use it. Did you know that?
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.elect: Lightning in your hands. I could feel it from across the field.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.telek: We share a gift, you and I. Mine just isn't enough any more.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.telep: You've been listening to my thoughts. Then you already know I won't stop.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.regen: You heal. You can't die. Of all of them, that's the one I need.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.time_: You move time like a watch hand. I fix watches.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.radia: You're the one who glows. The one who burns. Hold still.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.sonic: You see sound. I can hear something in yours. Let me look closer.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.super: You're fast. But you always come back to the same places.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.preco: You painted this, didn't you? Then you already know how it ends.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.pyrok: Fire that listens to you. Show me how.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.invis: Hiding doesn't work on me. I can hear your heart.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.phasi: Nothing can hold you. Let's see if I can.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.want.empat: You take a little from everyone you meet. So do I. We're the same, you and me.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.return_esc: You ran, last time. Everyone runs. It never matters.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.return_fle: You again. I've thought about the way you fight. I've been practising.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.yours: Recognise it? Your power. My hands.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.phase2: Do you know what it's like to want something this badly?
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.phase3: I'm not finished. I'm never finished.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.revive: I took that from someone who couldn't die.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.acquired: There it is. Now I understand.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.say.escape: This isn't over. I have all the time in the world.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.sense: You sense a cold, calculating mind to the %s. A terrible hunger hides behind the silence. Sylar is nearby.
action.heroesevolved.quake_0_1.desc: Strike one target up to 40 blocks away for 7 + level damage and a powerful directional shove.
action.heroesevolved.quake_1_1.desc: Damage visible enemies within 8 blocks and slow them for 5 seconds. Does not destroy terrain.
action.heroesevolved.quake_2_1.desc: Kick away from your aim while blasting nearby enemies backward. Useful in midair.
action.heroesevolved.flight_0_1.desc: Rush to a visible teammate or your tamed pet within 18 blocks, reset their fall and grant 8 seconds of Slow Falling plus two hearts of absorption.
action.heroesevolved.flight_1_1.desc: Corkscrew for 0.6 seconds, carrying your entry speed. Deflect a hostile projectile to bank 15 Momentum once per roll. Shift + key rolls left. Solid walls stop the roll.
action.heroesevolved.flight_2_1.desc: Aim at solid ground within 20 blocks. After 0.4 seconds, a 3.5-block-radius updraft lifts and damages enemies and cushions allies. Fly into your own column to gain a lift and 20 Momentum once per cast. Shift + key cancels the warning.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_0_1.des: Forge a crystal lance for 0.6 seconds, then launch it up to forty blocks. Its physical impact builds Frost, freezes prepared targets, and shatters frozen enemies. Cover stops its flight.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_1_1.des: Raise six orbiting ice plates for eight seconds. Each catches a hostile projectile or absorbs part of an impact; heat melts plates faster. Press again to launch the remaining plates as an aimed shard fan.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_2_1.des: Send an expanding cold front across seven blocks. Fresh enemies gain Frost, prepared targets freeze, and already frozen enemies shatter. The travelling front strikes each enemy once and stops at cover.
Shock a target up to 40 blocks away for 8 + level damage, briefly stagger it, then arc to two nearby enemies.
Leave a 6-second electric screen that reflects incoming projectiles within 7 blocks.
Electrify your reflexes: Speed II and Haste II for 8 seconds, and fill your Charge to Overcharged.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_0_1.des: Launch a visible stone lance along your crosshair. It travels up to 40 blocks, collides with cover, and deals 8 damage.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_1_1.des: Anchor a five-second pull at your crosshair, gathering nearby enemies. Press again to release them upward; Shift cancels safely.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_2_1.des: Press against a temporary force foothold to vault forward and upward. Shift reverses the vault. Movement collides normally with the world.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_0_1.desc: Choose a command for a visible mob. Defend Me needs 60 Mind Thread Focus.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_1_1.desc: Link willing nearby minds; cast again on a linked friend to look through their eyes for five seconds. Esc returns.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_2_1.desc: Plant a private illusion in a player’s mind: your clone, an approaching zombie or creeper, a false chest, or a small shelter. Contact or interaction dissolves it.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_0_1.de: Purge your harmful status effects, extinguish yourself, and instantly restore 6 health.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_1_1.de: Heal 4 health and gain Speed II and Haste for 8 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_2_1.de: Sacrifice 3 health to heal a target up to 40 blocks away for 10 health and grant Absorption for 10 seconds. Requires more than 4 health.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_0: Suspend a visible target up to 40 blocks away for 4-5.5 seconds, including its AI and actions. One target at a time.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_1: Shift + key remembers safe ground. Press normally to return within 512 blocks in the same dimension. Destination must remain loaded and clear.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_2: Return yourself to five seconds ago, recovering lost health and reducing fire. Leaves inventories, blocks and everyone else untouched. Requires five seconds of history.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_0_1.desc: Irradiate a target up to 40 blocks away for 9 + level damage and a stage of Radiation Sickness.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_1_1.desc: Condense a protective layer around yourself for Resistance II for 8 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_2_1.desc: Purge harmful effects and flames from yourself and teammates within 8 blocks, then grant 8 seconds of Fire Resistance.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_0_1: Concentrate your scream on one target up to 40 blocks away for 9 + level damage and knockback.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_1_1: Scream at visible enemies within 8 blocks for 3 damage, Weakness II for 6 seconds and a strong 4-second slow.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_2_1: Gain Resistance and leave a 5-second sonic screen that reflects incoming projectiles within 7 blocks.
ability.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance.de: See sound as colour and make it a weapon: Emma Coolidge's music and Black Canary's voice.
ability.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance.pa: Sound Sight: every sound near you blooms as colour where it was made, through walls (monsters red, animals green, players violet, blocks and footsteps gold, music every colour). Sonic hits and nearby explosions build Resonance.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_cry.desc: Tap for a focused cry: damage and shove enemies in a narrow cone and shatter glass in its path. Hold for the sustained scream, up to five seconds (6 extra stamina every half second). Your own cry pushes you backward; crouch to brace against it. In the air nothing can brace you.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_note.desc: Set a humming note where you aim. It plays for eight seconds, and hostile mobs within sixteen blocks forget you and walk to it. Press again (or let it end) to break it on everything gathered there. With 30 Resonance the burst is harmonic: wider and half again as hard.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_wall.desc: Raise a five-block wall of sound just ahead for five seconds or more. Shots that reach it turn back, and become yours. Enemies in it are pushed away and hurt. Shift + key drops it.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_vault.desc: Cry at the ground behind you to leap away from your aim. Your next landing within ten seconds takes no damage, and a real fall lands on a shockwave that throws back everything around you.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_crescendo.des: Hold to build, up to three seconds; let go to release one wave in a wide cone, 16 to 32 blocks long. It is harder the longer you built and spends all your Resonance for more. It shatters glass, ice and leaves, and leaves everything slowed and weakened.
intro.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance.char: Every breath vibrates. The air begins to bend around you.
intro.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance.rele: Your first scream sends a ring of resonance through the world.
subtitles.heroesevolved.sonic_scream: A sustained sonic scream tears through the air
screen.heroesevolved.skills_button.desc: See every ability your power has, then open the skill tree to spend points.
action.heroesevolved.temporal_snapshot.d: Shift + key records this area. Press normally to visit its recorded past with nearby companions; press again there to return. A recorded past, not arbitrary calendar travel.
time.heroesevolved.anchor_ground: Stand on safe ground to remember this destination.
time.heroesevolved.anchor_set: Destination remembered. Press without Shift to return here (up to 512 blocks).
time.heroesevolved.anchor_dimension: Remember a destination in this dimension first: Shift + skill key.
time.heroesevolved.anchor_blocked: That destination is blocked, unloaded, unsafe, or more than 512 blocks away.
time.heroesevolved.history: Live through five seconds here before using Second Chance.
time.heroesevolved.stopped: Still World: %s seconds | Shift + key to resume
time.heroesevolved.slowed: Between Seconds: %s seconds | Shift + key to resume
story.heroesevolved.time.vision: You witnessed Odessa's Last Day. The bunker receiver has news from the present.
story.heroesevolved.time.rescue: No One Left Behind: another life crossed the seam with you. Remember a safe place with Spatial Anchor; a hero needs a way home.
story.heroesevolved.time.anchor: A Place to Return: a destination fixed in your memory. Next, learn to undo a mistake with Rewrite the Moment.
story.heroesevolved.time.rewrite: The Butterfly Effect: the last fifteen seconds happened differently. Master Walk the Past: a moment you record is a moment you can return to.
story.heroesevolved.time.travel: The Road Not Taken: a moment you record is a place you can return to.
ability.heroesevolved.superspeed.passive: Accelerate to eat food 4x faster and outrun slowed time. Level 3: sprint across water; level 4: short wall climbs. Crouch to dive. Cold can stop you.
action.heroesevolved.speed_accelerate.de: Toggle, then sprint at 4-8x speed. Running builds Momentum (shown under your keys): at 50 lightning crackles over you, at 60 you buffet enemies you run past, at 100 you break the sound barrier. Walk or crouch for precision; press again to stop.
action.heroesevolved.speed_blitz.desc: Rush the enemy you look at (up to 22 blocks) and land four blows in a fraction of a second. Press again within a moment and you are already on the next enemy nearby, up to six in a chain. 30 Momentum makes the blows harder. With no one in sight, it is a straight dash.
action.heroesevolved.speed_snatch.desc: In one blink, take every dropped item within reach, pluck enemy shots out of the air (arrows go in your pocket), and take the weapon from the hand you look at. Another player's weapon is knocked to their feet instead. To anyone watching, you never moved.
action.heroesevolved.speed_cyclone.desc: Run rings around where you stand for three seconds. The wind drags enemies around and up, flings their shots away, and hurts them every half second; then it breaks and throws them all up and out. Hold the key and the ring rises into a tornado that carries them high up its funnel until you let go (it costs stamina while it stands). Shift + key: Wind Arms. Spin your arms into two funnels of wind while you hold it: look ahead to blow enemies and shots away, look down to lift off the ground.
action.heroesevolved.speed_lightspeed.de: Streak up to 48 blocks forward along a clear path. Everything on the line is struck (8 + tier + Momentum / 5), set briefly alight and thrown aside, and a sonic boom goes off where you stop. Spends all your Momentum.
speed.heroesevolved.enabled: Accelerate ready. Sprint to run; walk or crouch for precision. Press the ability again to stop.
speed.heroesevolved.exhausted: Out of stamina. Your speed fades.
speed.heroesevolved.awakened: Your heartbeat races. The world falls behind. Use Accelerate, then sprint to find your pace.
intro.heroesevolved.superspeed.charge_su: A heartbeat stretches. Golden sparks race across your skin.
intro.heroesevolved.superspeed.release_s: The world is still moving. You are simply faster.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_0_1.desc: For 6 seconds, dodge an incoming projectile sideways if there is a clear escape path. Each successful dodge costs 3 stamina; at most once per second.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_1_1.desc: Rush a visible enemy up to 40 blocks away along a clear path and land a powerful strike. Cannot pass through walls.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_2_1.desc: Carry a nearby villager, friendly creature, teammate or crouching player up to 12 blocks ahead. Both bodies need a clear path.
ability.heroesevolved.precognition.descr: See what is coming, paint it, and change it.
ability.heroesevolved.precognition.passi: Danger Sense: foreseen harm is painted in red, privately. A shot's path and where it lands, a blast before it goes off, a bow drawn at you, Sylar on your trail. Each foreseen harm that misses you earns Clarity. Your awakening paints two sleepers sending a signal.
For eight seconds, Danger Sense reaches half again as far, every enemy nearby shows a gold ghost of where it is about to be, mobs that chose you glow, and the unseen are revealed.
action.heroesevolved.precog_paint.desc: A short painting trance. With an enemy in view, paint their ending: for fifteen seconds everyone hurts them 20% more, and at a quarter of their health (up to half, spending Clarity) it comes true. With no one in view, paint the relay station's signal, Sylar, or what is near.
action.heroesevolved.precog_saw_it_comin: For a moment and a half, the next blow misses: you are already a step aside. Its attacker is Exposed (your next hit on it deals 50% more), you gain Clarity, and Saw It Coming is ready again in a second.
For eight seconds, cross out one lethal outcome for a friend in view within twelve blocks, or yourself with Shift. They are left at one heart and need help. A rescued person cannot be spared again for thirty seconds.
action.heroesevolved.precog_future_writt: Spend all your Clarity to live two seconds ahead of everyone: four seconds, plus one for every ten Clarity. Every blow is sidestepped (6 stamina each), shots that would hit you are crossed out of the air, your hits deal 30% more, and every enemy shows its ghost.
Write a twelve-step fault along nearby ground. After two seconds it erupts outward, hitting each enemy once.
Brace for five seconds, absorbing half of incoming damage into a counterwave. Cast again to release; stored force releases at expiry.
action.heroesevolved.quake_seamfinder.de: Open a small seam in the aimed wall. Only ordinary blocks of hardness 2 or less fracture; containers are spared.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_rime_lo: Grow a sixteen-block temporary ice path one segment at a time. Aim and press again while it grows to bend the remaining weave. Each segment lasts twelve seconds and restores its original terrain.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_stillhe: Shelter yourself or a willing friend in a pressure-bearing ice cocoon. Its finite shell absorbs impacts, then opens with recovery and a harmless-to-allies Frost pulse. Press again to open early; Shift targets yourself.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_brittle: Mark up to four visible enemies with crystal stars. Frost applied to one feeds the other visible links. Shattering a frozen star sends a staged fracture chain between them; solid cover breaks the chain.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_circ: Trace up to 48 connected iron, copper, chain, or lightning-rod blocks. Enemies touching the network are shocked once. Can overload the annex relay partition.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_grou: Leave an eight-second grounding field. Nearby allies shed 40% of incoming projectile damage into it. Cast again to discharge up to 16 stored damage nearby.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_arc_: Place up to three anchors by aiming at surfaces. Connecting wires shock each crossing enemy once; anchors must be within 24 blocks of one another.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_0_1.de: Read the annex incident and briefly outline nearby villagers, including captives through walls.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_1_1.de: Mark the intentions of three nearby enemies. Each loses its next damaging attack against you or a nearby friend during four seconds.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_2_1.de: Share six seconds of committed-threat warnings with nearby scoreboard teammates.
ability.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis.passiv: Fire cannot hurt you; lava too from Level 3. Level 2 punches ignite. Attacks build Heat, turning flames blue at 80. Heat fuels flight boosts and heavier attacks. Water quenches you; cold hurts more. Crouch while casting to contain terrain fire.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_flare.desc: Tap for a fire bolt or hold to forge a piercing spear. Full charge can spend 20 Heat to widen the strike. Burning enemies can detonate, and a full charge primes armed Ember Mines in its path.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_flame_palm.des: Hold to sweep a cone of flame, build Heat and push enemies back. Aim at your Firestorm to widen and intensify it. Works during Flame Flight.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_ring_of_fire.d: Mark the ground, then raise an eight-second wall of flame that draws burning enemies inward and consumes hostile shots. Feed it with Breath, or use Shift + this key to collapse it.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_backdraft.desc: Toggle jets with this key or double-tap Jump. Scroll for throttle and hold Sprint + Forward for a Heat-powered afterburner. Shift + this key gathers flame, then plunges in a Meteor Dive.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_inferno.desc: Hold to grow a miniature sun over a locked target. Release to drop it onto the marked area. Longer charges and stored Heat strengthen the impact. Shift + this key cancels the charge.
pyro.heroesevolved.flight_controls: WASD · steer   Scroll · throttle   Space / Shift · height
pyro.heroesevolved.flight_stop: Flight key · land   Shift + flight key · Meteor Dive
pyro.heroesevolved.flight_started: FLAME FLIGHT — scroll for throttle, hold Forward to cruise
intro.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis.charge_s: Your hands are hot. Too hot. Smoke curls between your fingers.
intro.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis.release_: The fire escapes all at once, and it does not burn you.
pyro.heroesevolved.inferno_cancelled: You swallow the flames. Sunfall cancelled.
pyro.heroesevolved.no_ground: There's no ground there to hide an ember.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_0_1.des: Lash a visible enemy within 40 blocks for 6 + level damage and five seconds of burning, then reel them toward you for 0.4 seconds. The tether stops at three blocks or when cover breaks the connection.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_ember_m: Hide up to two embers for 40 seconds. Enemies, a fully charged Cinder Spear, or Blue Lance can trigger an armed ember. It gives a visible warning for 0.4 seconds before erupting for 6 + level fire damage.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_1_1.des: Raise rotating flame plates for eight seconds: Resistance, a burning aura within 2.5 blocks, and hostile-projectile interception within 3. Each consumed projectile feeds 2 Heat, up to 8 every quarter-second. Allied shots pass through.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_blue_la: Pierce 24 blocks for (8 + level) x 1.5 blue fire damage. The seam stays for 0.6 seconds and pulses for 2.5 damage every four ticks. It primes armed Ember Mines in its path. Solid cover and water stop it.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_2_1.des: Seal the wounds of an injured or afflicted friend in sight within eight blocks, or yourself: heal 4 + level, clear harmful effects and extinguish flames. Automatically spends 20 Heat, when available, for four health of absorption lasting five seconds.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_fire_sh: Draw in up to 32 nearby fires, restoring stamina and health plus 2 Heat per fire, up to 40 Heat. Extinguishes burning friends within five blocks and heals them for 2. Thaw also releases nearby friends from cold.
item.heroesevolved.empty_syringe.tooltip: Draws blood from a Regeneration owner: yourself, someone crouching to consent, or someone helpless.
item.heroesevolved.formula_vial.tooltip: Needs an Empty Syringe. Use to inject yourself, or use on a crouching player.
formula.heroesevolved.donor_thanks: You gave your blood to %s. It's already healing.
formula.heroesevolved.bottled: Your Blood Gift fills the syringe instead.
formula.heroesevolved.forced_victim: %s drove a needle into you and took your blood. You feel drained.
formula.heroesevolved.rescue_sample: One of the rescued captives presses a vial of regenerating blood into your hand: "They wanted this. Make it count."
formula.heroesevolved.draw.not_regenerat: %s's blood isn't regenerative. The Formula needs a Regeneration owner.
formula.heroesevolved.draw.refused: %s won't let you. Ask them to crouch, or they must be helpless (and PvP allowed).
formula.heroesevolved.draw.protected: %s was drained recently. Their blood hasn't recovered yet.
formula.heroesevolved.draw.not_helpless: %s is fighting you off. They must be frozen, held, stopped, asleep or badly hurt, or crouch to consent.
formula.heroesevolved.draw.disabled: Forced blood draws are disabled on this server. %s must crouch to consent.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.no_needle: You need an Empty Syringe to inject the Formula.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.consent: %s must crouch to accept the injection.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.eclipse: The Formula is inert under the black sun.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.already_pow: Your body already carries a power. It violently rejects the Formula.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.nothing_lef: There's nothing left in you to awaken. Every power is already claimed.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.rejected: Your body rejects the Formula. Fever, then nothing.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.awakened: The Formula takes hold. Something inside you wakes up.
advancement.heroesevolved.save_the_cheer: Donate your regenerating blood for the Formula
advancement.heroesevolved.the_formula.de: Awaken a power with a synthesized Formula
cryochamber.heroesevolved.entered: The pod seals. Your respawn point is set here. Sneak to step out.
cryochamber.heroesevolved.occupied: Someone is already sleeping in this pod.
cryochamber.heroesevolved.locked: The revival protocol is still running. The door won't open yet.
cryochamber.heroesevolved.charged: You flood the pod with cold. It will heal faster for five minutes.
intro.heroesevolved.bunker_1.charge_subt: Pod power critical. Emergency revival protocol engaged.
intro.heroesevolved.bunker_2.charge_subt: Frost on the glass. Red light. An alarm nobody has answered in a very long time.
bunker.heroesevolved.hint: Check the signal receiver in Records. Press %s for your Journal.
bunker.heroesevolved.rumor: Something has opened beneath the world's spawn: a sealed bunker, deep under X %s, Z %s. The ladder starts at a trapdoor on the surface. Press %s to open your Journal and follow the lead.
advancement.heroesevolved.wake_up.title: Wake Up
advancement.heroesevolved.wake_up.descri: Wake from stasis in the Odessa bunker
action.heroesevolved.flight_sky_catch.de: Aim at solid ground within 20 blocks to shelter a 5-block area for 6 seconds. Friends land softly; incoming hostile projectiles slow and turn outward once. Shift + key dismisses it.
action.heroesevolved.flight_tailwind.des: Lay a 12-block wind lane for 8 seconds. Friends gain Speed II, Jump Boost and Slow Falling; enemies are carried along it. Solid terrain clips its reach. Shift + key dismisses it.
Draw visible enemies inward for 0.4 seconds, then clap out a 6-block pressure wave. Release spends Momentum for a harder burst. Shift + key cancels before release and keeps Momentum.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_remote_: Pull a loose item along your sightline or operate a lever, button, door, trapdoor, gate or bell up to 24 blocks away.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_kinetic: Gather three visible fragments and launch them in sequence at your aimed point. Each deals 4 damage and collides with creatures and cover.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_force_b: A moving three-block shell deflects incoming hostile projectiles and pushes enemies out for six seconds. Press again for an outward release; Shift cancels.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_persuasio: A suggestion that cannot be refused. A mob becomes your ally and fights your enemies for 20 seconds; a villager gives you hero's discounts; a hostile player cannot attack you for six seconds.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_memory_wa: Read a mind up to 24 blocks away. Players reveal their power; every unseen player within 32 blocks is exposed for ten seconds.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_hive_link: Link the minds of nearby teammates for thirty seconds: they see each other through walls and in the dark.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_take_t: Heal a friend up to 8 health and take half of it as your own wound.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_adapta: For thirty seconds, each repeat of the same kind of harm hurts 40% less.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_revive: Pull a friend below 30% health back to 60%, with Regeneration II.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_s: Seal a point in time for ten seconds: projectiles entering it hang frozen. Cast again to throw them all where you look.
Fold space to an aimed surface within 24 blocks, bringing up to three friends beside you.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_a: Years pass in a moment around you: crops, saplings and young animals within three blocks grow up.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_heat_vent: Dump up to 30 stress into a cone ahead, burning everything in it.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_reactor_c: Turn up to 20 stress into stamina, and give nearby friends a burst of energy.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_glowing_p: Contaminate the ground around you for ten seconds; enemies standing in it sicken.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_sha: Find a resonant frequency: glass, ice and leaves around an aimed point up to 24 blocks away shatter.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_ech: Sound out the rock: ores within twelve blocks glimmer for you alone.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_qui: A six-block field of silence for ten seconds: mobs inside lose their targets.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_mirage.d: Afterimages fill the air for six seconds: mobs hunting you lose the trail and stumble.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_lightnin: Spend your Momentum (at least 30) to hurl a bolt of your own lightning at an enemy within 32 blocks. It counts as electricity.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_percepti: For six seconds the world slows around you: everything within 12 blocks moves at a third of its speed, enemy players are dragged down, and projectiles crawl.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_foresi: For ten seconds, sidestep the next three blows you see coming.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_find_t: A vision points the way to the nearest Helixite within 32 blocks.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_shared: For eight seconds, any teammate within 24 blocks braces the moment something chooses them as prey.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_0_1.de: Fade for three seconds and prepare one surprise melee strike. Your next hit within ten seconds reveals you as it lands.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_smoke_: Project footsteps and a refracted flicker at aimed ground. Nearby hostile mobs investigate the false trail instead of your hidden position.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_1_1.de: Leave an optical double, fade for six seconds and gain Resistance while you reposition.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_pickpo: Lift a mob's held item from within four blocks and quietly operate doors or containers while faded.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_2_1.de: Vanish for five seconds with Speed II and leave hunters searching your last known position.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_cloak_: Lay a twelve-block optical passage for fifteen seconds. Solid walls clip its reach; consenting companions inside remain concealed.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_0_1.desc: Reach Through an enemy you can see up to 40 blocks away: the blow ignores armor and stops them healing.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_phase_carry: Pass through the wall ahead at Full Ghost, bringing up to three friends.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_1_1.desc: Snap to Full Dense, free of upkeep, for six seconds.
Embed an enemy up to 16 blocks away.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_2_1.desc: Three seconds at Full Ghost, free of upkeep.
Drop through the floor to the open space below with up to three friends. Shift rises instead.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_0_: Lash out with a borrowed instinct at an enemy up to 40 blocks away: 6 + level damage.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_se: Feel every powered person and Sylar within 48 blocks; they glow for you for eight seconds.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_1_: You and nearby teammates feel each other's strength: Strength for eight seconds.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_ov: Your next Echo uses the borrowed power at your full level.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_2_: Soothe yourself and nearby teammates, clearing harmful effects.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_ab: Take a friend's harmful effects onto yourself at half duration, and heal them for 4.
ability.heroesevolved.invisibility.passi: Bend light around your body, armor and held items. Careful movement keeps Exposure low; sprinting, attacks, water and damage leave revealing distortion. Higher levels control the shimmer more reliably. Sensing powers and fire can still expose you.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_fade.d: Toggle concealment while stamina lasts. Walking carefully keeps Exposure low; sprinting leaves distortion. Press again or Shift + this key to reappear.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_silent: Dash physically along your aim for a few moments, peeling away a refracted silhouette. Solid terrain stops the dash; it does not break your Fade.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_unseen: Send an optical double along a false route for six seconds. Everyone can see it; mobs investigate it. Testing the double shatters it into light.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_shroud: Carry a moving veil for twelve seconds, concealing nearby consenting companions. Each covered friend drains stamina; attacking exposes only the attacker.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_ghost_: For eight seconds, Exposure builds much more slowly and optical echoes peel away from your route. Hunters must find your real position; sensing powers can still reveal you.
ability.heroesevolved.phasing.passive: Your density is a dial, from Full Ghost to Full Dense, and holding a notch away from the middle costs stamina. At Ghost, walk into a wall to pass through it (crouch to lean on it instead); shots go through you, and at Full Ghost so do blows, though yours don't land either. At Dense you are heavy as stone: no knockback, harder punches that crack blocks, and at Full Dense a fall ends in a shockwave. You cannot suffocate, and a passage always ends in open space. Bedrock, barriers and protected ground stop you.
ability.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry.p: Absorb the powers of people near you. Echo I, II and III use the remembered power's first three abilities, a level weaker. You remember one power per level (four at level 5). Near another powered player you regain stamina.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_empathize.d: Absorb the power of the player (or Sylar) you look at within eight blocks. Copying never takes their power away.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_recall.desc: Choose which remembered power to channel. Shift steps backwards.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_echo_1.desc: Use the channeled power's first ability.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_echo_2.desc: Use the channeled power's second ability.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_echo_3.desc: Use the channeled power's third ability.
intro.heroesevolved.invisibility.charge_: Your hands go pale, then clear. Then they are gone.
intro.heroesevolved.invisibility.release: For a few seconds the world forgets you exist.
intro.heroesevolved.phasing.charge_subti: Your feet sink a finger's width into solid stone.
intro.heroesevolved.phasing.release_subt: Nothing can quite hold you anymore.
intro.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry.cha: Every power nearby hums like a second heartbeat.
intro.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry.rel: Whatever they can do, you can learn.
intro.heroesevolved.precognition.charge_: Gold ghosts move a heartbeat ahead of everything trying to hurt you.
intro.heroesevolved.precognition.release: Every blow you saw coming misses. Your hands are already painting what comes next.
invisibility.heroesevolved.faded: You fade from sight. Press again to reappear.
invisibility.heroesevolved.exhausted: Out of stamina. You flicker back into view.
invisibility.heroesevolved.strike_ready: Your next blow comes from nowhere.
invisibility.heroesevolved.awakened: For a moment, nobody can see you. Not even you.
invisibility.heroesevolved.nothing_to_ta: Nobody close is holding anything worth taking.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_shift.desc: Turn your density one notch toward Ghost. With Shift held, one notch toward Dense. Holding a notch costs stamina; run out and it slips back.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_reach.desc: Sink your hand into an enemy within 4 blocks: 5 + level damage that ignores armor, they can't heal for five seconds, and you pull out their off-hand item or a piece of armor. Aimed at a wall, reach through up to two blocks and take the first stack from the chest, barrel or furnace behind it.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_embed.desc: Phase the enemy you look at (within 6 blocks) halfway into the floor and make them solid again. They can't move but can still fight, take 50% more damage, and struggle free sooner if they fight it.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_sink.desc: Drop into the ground and move through it, feeling the footsteps of everything above. Your Breath runs out in about ten seconds. Press again to surface with an uppercut for anyone standing over you.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_hollow.desc: The ground around you goes soft: every enemy within 6 + level blocks sinks chest-deep for five seconds and takes damage while stuck. At Dense, Bedrock Slam instead: a shockwave around you and Resistance III for four seconds.
density.heroesevolved.nothing_to_reach: There is nothing within reach to put your hand into.
density.heroesevolved.empty: Your fingers close on nothing. It's empty.
density.heroesevolved.embedded: You've been sunk into the ground! Struggle to break free.
density.heroesevolved.need_ground: You need solid ground under your feet to sink into.
density.heroesevolved.out_of_breath: Out of breath! The ground throws you out.
density.heroesevolved.hollow_none: The ground goes soft, but there's no one here to swallow.
carry.heroesevolved.too_big: Too big to carry in your arms.
phasing.heroesevolved.no_passage: There's no open space on the other side, or something you can't pass is in the way.
phasing.heroesevolved.intangible: Your body loosens. Things pass through you. Press again to solidify.
phasing.heroesevolved.exhausted: Out of stamina. Your density slips a notch back toward normal.
phasing.heroesevolved.awakened: Your hand passes through the wall before you understand why. For a moment you are barely there.
mimicry.heroesevolved.empty: You haven't absorbed anyone's power yet. Look at someone with a power and Empathize.
mimicry.heroesevolved.no_one: There's no one close enough to feel.
mimicry.heroesevolved.nothing_there: %s has no awakened power to feel.
mimicry.heroesevolved.overcharged: Your next Echo will burn at full strength.
mimicry.heroesevolved.awakened: Every power near you hums. Empathize to remember one.
technique.heroesevolved.remote_hand.noth: There's nothing there your mind can work: a lever, button, door, trapdoor, gate or bell.
technique.heroesevolved.persuasion.compe: %s's voice is in your head. You can't bring yourself to strike them.
technique.heroesevolved.memory_walk.none: %s has no power. Just a mind.
technique.heroesevolved.revive.none: No friend in sight is close enough to death to pull back.
technique.heroesevolved.echo_map: The rock answers: %s ore veins glimmer.
You need at least 30 Momentum. Run first.
technique.heroesevolved.find_the_path.he: Helixite lies about %s blocks away. Follow the light.
technique.heroesevolved.find_the_path.vi: In the vision: a village near X %s, Z %s.
painting.heroesevolved.explosion.title: The Man Who Was the Bomb
painting.heroesevolved.explosion.author: Isaac Mendez
painting.heroesevolved.sleeper.title: The Sleeper Wakes
painting.heroesevolved.sleeper.author: Isaac Mendez
painting.heroesevolved.bennets.title: The Bennets, Odessa
painting.heroesevolved.bennets.author: Sandra Bennet
painting.heroesevolved.eclipse.title: The Black Sun
painting.heroesevolved.eclipse.author: Isaac Mendez
hud.heroesevolved.flight_tempest: TEMPEST  •  Aim to steer the eye
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_second: Give a friend your blood (50 Regrowth): they heal fully, and for a minute their next death leaves them standing.
hud.heroesevolved.give_up: Hold %s to give up and wake at home
cryo.heroesevolved.prison_struggle: Press Jump or Attack to crack the ice
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_bar: Fold a three-wide, two-high shield of matter up out of the ground in front of you. Shift + this key dismantles your constructs.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_sha: Tear a Shard out of the ground and fire it up to 64 blocks. Cover stops it; Bank Shot can ricochet it off your own walls.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_cau: For eight seconds, matter catches every step you take on air: walk out over gaps, jump to climb, crouch to drop. Each plate crumbles a moment after you leave it.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_cag: Close a tight cell of matter round a visible enemy. Occupied cells and existing terrain are left clear; enemies can break out.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_cat: Raise three sentinel turrets round you. For twenty seconds their crystal heads shoot Shards at enemies they can see within 32 blocks.
ability.heroesevolved.technopathy.passiv: Read and command physical machine networks. Link real switches, prepare relay traps and intercept hostile projectiles. Copper, redstone and nearby mechanisms become your infrastructure.
ability.heroesevolved.matter_assembly.pa: Draw matter up out of the ground into lean, temporary constructs and physical Shards. It costs stamina, never your blocks; every cell gives no loot and vanishes safely. Bank Shards off your walls, walk on air, and let your sentinels do the shooting.
intro.heroesevolved.technopathy.charge_s: The machines around you begin to make sense. Not words. Connections.
intro.heroesevolved.technopathy.release_: Every mechanism has a purpose. Now you can change it.
intro.heroesevolved.matter_assembly.char: You can see how it fits
Edges, joints and load-bearing lines arrange themselves behind your eyes.
intro.heroesevolved.matter_assembly.rele: The world is material. What you build from it is your choice.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_swi: Fold a narrow staircase of matter through a right-angle turn toward your aim. Look up to climb, down to descend.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_dra: Project a narrow twenty-block crossing over a gap. Cast again to retract that crossing from its far end.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_sca: Tear five Shards from the ground and launch them in a fan. Each flies and collides on its own, and cover stops them.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_fau: Pillars of matter burst up in a travelling line over solid ground, launching nearby enemies upward without harming allies or replacing terrain.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_she: Raise a snug, roofed hut of matter round yourself with a doorway behind you. Occupied cells are always skipped.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_cra: Aim at a consenting teammate or use it on yourself. Build a safety floor two blocks below them, even over a void.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_handsha: Enrol up to 24 physically connected copper, iron and redstone nodes for two minutes. Severed conductors sever the network. Shift + this key clears it.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_remote_: Operate a linked lever, button, door, gate, trapdoor or copper bulb at range. Real circuits respond, and protected devices refuse you.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_tripwir: String a visible tripwire from the aimed relay to the furthest clear linked relay. Hostile crossings recoil and stumble; allies pass. Shift + this key clears wires.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_interce: Prepare a ten-second, five-block field above an aimed relay that diverts incoming hostile arrows. Walls and alliance rules apply. Shift + this key ends it.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_machine: For twelve seconds, up to eight physical relays coordinate projectile interception and one recoil trap per hostile intruder. Shift + this key ends the district.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_batch_i: Send ON / OPEN to up to six linked controls. Hold Shift for OFF / CLOSED. Every real device checks its owner's permission separately.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_delayed: Queue the aimed linked control to toggle in three seconds. Shift queues OFF / CLOSED. An intervening manual command cancels your instruction.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_sentry_: Prepare a three-block proximity trap above a linked relay for thirty seconds. Its first hostile intruder is slammed back and briefly slowed; incoming arrows are intercepted when it fires.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_kill_sw: Switch an active linked controller OFF / CLOSED for five seconds, then safely restore its original state. The command never resurrects a broken or replaced device.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_winchli: A linked relay winches the nearest visible hostile within seven blocks towards itself for up to three seconds. Cover and collision break the tether.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_domino_: Send a fast mechanical recoil through twelve enrolled relays, one every four ticks. Each enemy can be struck only once by the sequence. Prepare a cable-lined corridor before the fight.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_blac: Drink the grid: for a second every machine and live circuit near you arcs into you, then a 20-block pulse kills redstone, drains and stops Forge Energy machines and seizes Create shafts for 12 seconds. Enemies within 12 blocks are shocked and plunged into darkness. What you drain becomes Charge.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_s: Fold space to a point where you aim. For five seconds it drags enemies within 10 blocks into a spiralling orbit, tears at anything at its core, and swallows hostile projectiles and loose items. Then it collapses in a shockwave, and what it swallowed lands at your feet.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_phoenix: Release a firebird that favors burning enemies. It dives through up to three foes, or four from tier 5, then returns to heal you and restore Heat for each strike. A Phoenix cast at blue Heat burns hotter.
action.heroesevolved.quake_fissure_maw.d: Split the ground in a line 14 blocks long in front of you. Slabs heave up either side of a glowing crack, and foes along it take 10 + 2 per tier and are hurled into the air.
action.heroesevolved.quake_stone_rampart: Slabs of rock burst up in an arc in front of you for 10 seconds. They stop projectiles from that side and push back anyone who comes at you through them.
action.heroesevolved.quake_bedrock_stanc: The ground ripples outward from you. You and friends within 10 blocks cannot be knocked back and take less damage for 8 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.flight_tempest_dril: Corkscrew forward 18 blocks in half a second inside a tunnel of wind. Foes you pass through take 9 + 2 per tier and are flung aside.
action.heroesevolved.flight_gale_wall.de: A wall of wind wheels around you for 8 seconds, throwing projectiles back the way they came and pushing anyone close out of it.
action.heroesevolved.flight_formation_fl: Lift everyone near you. You and friends within 12 blocks get a burst upward, fall gently, run faster and jump higher for 10 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_hailsto: A storm cloud gathers over a point up to 30 blocks away and hammers it with hail for four seconds. Foes within 5 blocks are struck again and again, slowed and chilled.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_crystal: Crystal pillars burst up in a ring around you for 8 seconds. They shatter incoming projectiles, push foes back out of the ring, and you resist damage while they stand.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_aurora_: Curtains of aurora hang over you for 10 seconds. Friends beneath them, within 8 blocks, regenerate and cannot burn; foes there are slowed.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_tesl: Raise a coil on a mast up to 20 blocks away. For 6 seconds it strikes the three nearest foes within 9 blocks twice a second, for 4 damage each and a moment's slowness.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_fara: A cage of lightning closes around you for 6 seconds. It burns projectiles out of the air, and anyone who strikes you is shocked for 4 and slowed.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_jump: Current leaps from you through up to five friends within reach. Each heals 6, is freed of slowness and weakness and gains speed for 6 seconds; you heal 4.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_implosi: Fold space in on a point up to 24 blocks away. For a second foes within 6 blocks are dragged in with the rubble, then everything near the centre is crushed for 12 + 2 per tier and slammed down.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_debris_: Two rings of rubble whirl around you for 8 seconds. They catch projectiles and batter anyone who comes close.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_gatheri: Haul every friend within 16 blocks to your side and close a bubble of force around each of you: strong damage resistance for 5 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_psychic_s: A storm of thought wheels over a point up to 24 blocks away for 6 seconds. Foes within 6 blocks take psychic damage, reel, and turn on one another.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_blind_spo: Slip out of every mind around you. Anything hunting you within 16 blocks loses you, and nothing can pick you out for 5 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_hive_mind: Link up to six of you within 14 blocks for 10 seconds. Damage any of you takes is shared out evenly among the others.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_vital_: Spend 4 of your own health in a double heartbeat of light. Foes within 6 blocks take 10 + 2 per tier, and you heal 2 for each one hit.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_undyin: For 6 seconds nothing can take your last heart. When it ends you heal 30% of your health.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_lifebl: A tree of light grows where you stand for 12 seconds. Friends within 7 blocks heal steadily and are cured of poison and wither.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_h: A clock face opens around you and its hour hand, a blade of gold light 7 blocks long, sweeps once all the way round. Every foe it passes takes 9 + 2 per tier and is slowed.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_t: Mark this moment for 6 seconds. When the loop closes you return to the health you had when it opened, with harmful effects undone. A blow that would kill you closes it early instead.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_b: Lend time to everyone near you. You and friends within 10 blocks move and work much faster for 8 seconds and regain 15 stamina.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_ground_ze: Throw a mote of your core up to 32 blocks. It hangs there glowing for a second and a half, then goes off: the Odessa blast in small, with its flash, fireball and mushroom cloud. Foes within 9 blocks take 10 + 2 per tier, plus up to 12 more near the centre, are irradiated and thrown. No blocks are broken.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_containme: Lead-glass panels lock into a dome 5 blocks across around where you stand for 8 seconds. Hostile projectiles that reach it are swallowed, you and your friends inside take 35% less damage, and foes inside are slowly irradiated.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_reactor_h: Raise a reactor's glowing heart at your feet for 10 seconds. Friends within 7 blocks gain absorption, and while they stay near it they regenerate quickly, dig faster and regain stamina.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_res: Stack standing waves over a point up to 24 blocks away until they fold in on themselves: foes within 4.5 blocks take 12 + 2 per tier and are left staggered and weak.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_sil: A dome of dead air 5 blocks across stands where you are for 8 seconds. Projectiles inside lose their speed and drop; foes inside are weakened.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_bat: A five-line staff of light circles you. You and friends within 12 blocks gain strength and speed for 10 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_lightnin: Strike up to six foes within 12 blocks one after another, faster than they can see, for 5 + tier each, then stand where you started.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_phase_bl: Vibrate too fast to hit for 6 seconds: each blow has a 60% chance to pass straight through you.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_relay_ru: Run to every friend within 24 blocks and bring them back to your side in an instant. All of you are faster for 6 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_foreto: Paint a circle 3 blocks across on the ground up to 24 blocks away and cross it out. Two seconds later the painting comes true: whoever is still inside takes 16 + 3 per tier.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_branch: See three futures of yourself for 6 seconds. The first blow that would land misses: you are already standing in the safest of them.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_prophe: Paint the next fifteen seconds for everyone near you. Friends within 12 blocks are lucky, and a blow that would kill one of them leaves them on their last heart instead.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_sunfall: A star falls from high in the sky, trailing a long burning tail, onto a point up to 48 blocks away. Foes within 5 blocks of where it lands take 12 + 2 per tier, burn and are thrown. A pillar of fire stands there a moment after.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_ember_s: Wrap yourself in turning flame for 8 seconds: arrows and other projectiles burn up before they reach you, anyone who strikes you is set alight, and fire cannot hurt you.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_hearthf: Light a hearth at your feet for 12 seconds. Friends within 6 blocks heal steadily, are thawed and cannot burn.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_shadow: Vanish and strike up to three foes within 10 blocks from behind, one after another, for half again as much as usual. You stay unseen for 3 seconds afterwards.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_refrac: Bend light around yourself for 6 seconds: you are invisible and projectiles curve away from you.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_prism_: A haze of broken light settles 6 blocks around you for 10 seconds. Friends inside are unseen and regenerate; foes inside are blinded.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_phase_erupt: Sink into the ground and erupt beneath a point up to 20 blocks away. Foes within 3.5 blocks take 10 + 2 per tier and are thrown into the air.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_dense_bulwa: Make yourself unbelievably dense for 8 seconds: you take far less damage and cannot be moved, but you are slow.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_phase_field: Loosen everyone near you. For 8 seconds, projectiles pass straight through you and friends within 8 blocks, and other damage is reduced.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_pr: Let every power you remember out at once. Foes within 7 blocks take 8 + 2 per remembered power + tier, burn, slow and glow.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_em: Three sigils of borrowed colour circle you for 8 seconds. Each one catches a blow that would have landed, and gives you 5 stamina.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_ki: You and friends within 12 blocks heal 4 plus one per remembered power, and are cleansed of harmful effects.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_drone_s: Six drones of light circle you for 8 seconds, shooting the three nearest foes in sight within 12 blocks every three quarters of a second.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_firewal: Raise a hologram wall 5 blocks wide in front of you for 10 seconds. It deletes projectiles that cross it and burns and throws back anyone who tries.
action.heroesevolved.technopathy_overclo: Overclock everyone near you: you and friends within 12 blocks work much faster and move faster for 10 seconds, and regain 10 stamina.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_for: Assemble a cannon of crystal over your shoulder and fire five slugs at what you are looking at, each for 5 + tier.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_bul: Crystal panels lock into a shell around you for 8 seconds: extra absorption hearts, and projectiles shatter against it.
action.heroesevolved.matter_assembly_men: Crystal lace winds around you and friends within 10 blocks, giving absorption and regeneration for 8 seconds.
